burn._comment: policy-burn: the minting policy allows negative mints. unspendable-sink: the policy is locked, so 'burn' means sending to the always_fail script address below.

cardano._metadata: The burn tx carries CIP-20 metadata {msg:["world:<worldId>", "to:<evm address>"]}. The attester reads the recipient from here.

minter.admin: <Safe address: can pause, change caps, rotate attesters>

caps._unit: whole tokens; the deploy script scales by token.decimals

attesterAgent._comment: The AdaSouls agent that watches Cardano and proposes attestations. It signs at most ONE of the N attester signatures and never holds the admin role. Its ALMA identity and limits come from alma.yaml.
